notes: No business-identity schema type found (e.g. Store or Product). This is usually the single highest-value fix -- it tells answer engines what kind of business this is, where it is, and how to contact it, in a format they can parse directly.

No Review/AggregateRating markup found. Even if the business has real reviews elsewhere, without Review/AggregateRating schema on the site itself, answer engines can't easily surface a rating for this business.
No FAQPage markup found. FAQ schema is one of the more direct ways to get specific Q&A content picked up verbatim by answer engines.
